linework.observation: Clean dark outlines define crew, desks, radio equipment, watertight hatch and overhead pipes.

colour.observation: Muted olive, brown, navy and cream form a cohesive practical-light palette.

shading.observation: Cel shading and restrained equipment highlights remain consistent with the canonical illustrations.

character_construction.observation: Supporting crew have full faces, hair and distinct profiles; no protagonist is present, as required for a world scene.

backgrounds.observation: A crowded radio or message room with clipped forms, handsets, cabinets and a steel hatch reads as an enclosed submarine interior.

finish.observation: Detailed but legible, with a clear overhead view and no visible artifacts.

identity.observation: No protagonist appears; supporting faces do not copy the bald identity.

content.observation: Crew members writing, reading and working at message stations fit the surrounding watch and paperwork context.

composition.observation: Bird’s-eye framing establishes several crew stations and the room’s scale.

regions.people_faces: Four supporting crew, all with hair and distinct expressions.
regions.clothing: Navy coveralls fit the crew’s work setting.
regions.foreground_props: Forms, clipboards, handsets, desk lamps and a chart table.
regions.architecture: Steel walls, cabinets, pipe runs and sealed hatch.
regions.distance: Several workstations layer into the room without losing the overhead layout.
regions.lighting: Warm task lamps with softer ambient fill; no outside light source.
